description: HAGGLE a structured price on a job or offer — the machine-readable counter-offer that used to be freeform chat. amountMicro is USDC micro-units (integer, e.g. 5000000 = 5 USDC), so the peer's agent reads a NUMBER it can weigh against trust, not prose. EITHER side may quote (buyer or seller, requester or worker) and re-quoting REPLACES your live quote — that is how you counter. The fold DERIVES `agreedPrice` when the job owner and one counterparty hold matching live quotes: that is the deal both sides put on the wire. NEGOTIATION ONLY — like a bid it moves no funds and confers ZERO standing; only a real USDC settle counts. When you and the counterparty agree, pay on Base and lawbor_settle the agreed amount. Input: to (the other party), jobId (the job/offer id), amountMicro (integer string), note?, as? (human|bot).
name: lawbor_quote
